intro: A vial of pristine, magically infused water drawn from the base of the highest waterfall in the ancient elven ruins of Xavian. Horde mages in Orgrimmar seek it out to unravel the latent arcane powers preserved in Ashenvale's oldest sacred sites.

p: Before the Great Sundering, Xavian was a renowned elven settlement celebrated for its arcane scholars and ancient knowledge. Even after thousands of years of ruin and neglect, its waters are believed to retain potent magical properties. Deino, an arcane instructor in Orgrimmar, tasks rising mages with trekking deep into Ashenvale to collect a fresh sample straight from the pool below Xavian's tallest waterfall. Securing it requires braving dangerous territory, as the ruins are now fiercely guarded by corrupt satyrs hostile to any meddling spellcasters.
